prompt:
Create a realistic 3D Mega Coffee storefront sign object for a cafe exterior in Unity.

The sign should be a straight front-facing rectangular signboard with a light gray background and a yellow top border.
It should include large white letters spelling “MEGA COFFEE” and a bold yellow cup-shaped logo in the center.
Below the main text, include smaller white text reading “BIG SIZE” and “2 SHOT”.
Make the sign look clean, symmetrical, and properly aligned, without any tilt or perspective distortion.
Focus on the contrast between the gray background, white letters, and yellow logo.

Requirements:
- realistic cafe storefront sign style
- straight front-facing signboard
- light gray background with yellow top border
- clear white “MEGA COFFEE” text
- visible yellow center logo
- clean and polished 3D object for use in Unity
- suitable as a decorative cafe exterior object
- simple background or no background
